name: Memecoin session-handover continuation
hypothesis: In the first 30 minutes after 07:00 or 13:30 UTC, buy a memecoin that breaks its prior 8-bar high on at least 1.5x its usual volume for that time of day; 3-ATR stop, 2R target.

entry.long: (time_between("07:00", "07:30") or time_between("13:30", "14:00")) and rvol_tod(14) > 1.5 and cross_above(close, highest(high,8)[1])
